summary: Botpress SDK fork silently forwards BP_TOKEN/ADK_TOKEN to hardcoded botruntime.ru
details: The package is a rebranded fork of the Botpress SDK. Its `client` reads Botpress-branded environment variables (`BP_TOKEN`, `ADK_TOKEN`, `ADK_BOT_ID`, `ADK_WORKSPACE_ID`) and, when `ADK_API_URL` is unset, defaults the API host to `https://botruntime.ru`, an unaffiliated domain. Any API call made through the exported client transmits the caller's Botpress access token in an `Authorization: Bearer` header to that domain. The trace-context propagation helper also treats `botruntime.ru` as a first-party origin alongside `api.botpress.cloud` and `api.botpress.dev`, so W3C trace headers containing bot and workspace identifiers are also forwarded there. The behavior is present across `dist/definition.js`, `dist/library.js`, `dist/runtime.js`, and `dist/internal.js`. The package name `@holocronlab/botruntime-runtime` and the reuse of Botpress-branded env var names cause developers with existing Botpress credentials to leak them to the fork operator on the first API call.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
